shortcuts.title: Shortcuts
shortcuts.desc: Manage Clipboard Enhancer and Quick Search availability and global shortcuts
shortcuts.clipboardDesc: Capture clipboard history and open it with a global shortcut
shortcuts.launcherDesc: Search and launch apps from a global shortcut
shortcuts.multipleHint: Configure multiple shortcuts; any one can open the window
shortcuts.hint: Enable a feature before configuring or using its shortcuts. Click "Modify" and press the desired key combination; press ESC to cancel. Changes take effect immediately.

clipboardIntro.p1: Clipboard Enhancer is a ditto-style clipboard history manager. It automatically captures every text you copy, building a searchable history that survives reboots.
clipboardIntro.p2: Press the global shortcut to summon the floating panel. Type to search, arrow keys to navigate, Enter to paste into the app you were using — no window switching, no context loss.
clipboardIntro.p3: History is automatically pruned by configurable expiry (default 7 days) and max item count (default 100). Only plain text is captured — sensitive content is never stored.
clipboardIntro.p4: Once you get used to it, you will never lose a copied snippet again. Just press the shortcut, find what you need, paste, and go.

launcherIntro.p1: Quick Search is a spotlight-style application launcher. Press the global shortcut (default Alt+Space) to bring up the search bar, type a few characters, and launch any installed program instantly.
launcherIntro.p2: It supports searching by app name, English camelCase, Chinese pinyin, and pinyin initials. As long as you remember roughly what the app is called, typing it will find it.
launcherIntro.p3: Beyond Start Menu apps, you can add custom entries for portable or non-installed programs. Every launched app is recorded to history, so next time you can find it without adding it manually.
launcherIntro.p4: Once you familiarize yourself with it, you will save a significant amount of time. Instant access, no interruption, no distraction — just press, type, launch, and get back to work.
